symptom_text: around 2130 the night of the vaccine I started to have muscle spasms in my back, glute (right side), chest muscle and arms.  I felt ill when I went to bed.  I woke up to my Apple watch having "high heart rate" alerts (3 alerts) saying my sleeping heart rate was from 140-155 bpm (normal is 50-57).  When I woke up the morning after my vaccine I was sore and in pain in every muscle in my body.   It hurt to speak because my jaw was so sore all the way to the insides of my feet and everything in between was in pain (6/10) and sore.  I took 800mg Ibuprofen which brought my pain down to a 2/10 and I stayed in bed all day, into the night and part of the day after.    Since then I have been having PVC's (caught on ECG and my apple watch) and palpitations in my chest where my heart will race and I have a stabbing pain in the center of my chest.  My fingers and hands have been cold (and finger tips are turning purple some days) and I am finding it difficult to get warm which has never been a problem for me.  I notice a drastic brain fog, which has partially dissipated over the past few months.  I have a few swollen lymph nodes in my neck as well which are new to me.    As someone who is fit I am unable to run more then 100 yards without my pulse going into the 150's during moderate intensity.  This is also VERY abnormal.
